summary: Explain an authored agent loop with explicit tool and observation boundaries.
objective: Create an Agent Harness map where I can step an illustrative run from request to tool result and final response.
example_prompts: Create an Agent Harness map where I can step an illustrative run from request to tool result and final response.

entities.name: Harness boundary
entities.guidance: Use a frame enclosing planner, dispatcher and state store; spatial proximity is a chosen diagram layout.

entities.name: Tools
entities.guidance: Give each tool a distinct labeled port and response path; errors use shape/text as well as color.

entities.name: Event token
entities.guidance: Carry event ID and phase with each visible token; avoid implying that decorative routes are real network paths.

state_contract.model: Illustrative authored event trace: request, decision, tool-call, observation, continue or finish; no claim about a named vendor runtime.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Replay a failure branch and reset.

invariants: Tool results cannot appear before the corresponding call in this authored trace.
Pending, succeeded and failed remain distinct.
State panel and animation read the same trace index.
motion_guidance: Token travel illustrates ordering, not measured latency.
Separate pause of presentation from any external live process; default to labeled illustrative playback.
known_limits: This is an invented architecture and example trace, not a universal agent architecture.
Live integration needs a source adapter and actual event evidence before it can be described as observed execution.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.
